name: JSW Steel Ltd
description: JSW Steel Ltd is the flagship company of the JSW Group and India's largest private sector steel manufacturer by domestic capacity. Operating state-of-the-art facilities in Vijayanagar (Karnataka), Dolvi (Maharashtra), and Salem (Tamil Nadu), JSW Steel produces advanced flat and long steel products serving infrastructure, automotive, energy, and appliances sectors.

company_profile.summary: JSW Steel Ltd is the flagship company of the JSW Group and India's largest private sector steel manufacturer by domestic capacity. Operating state-of-the-art facilities in Vijayanagar (Karnataka), Dolvi (Maharashtra), and Salem (Tamil Nadu), JSW Steel produces advanced flat and long steel products serving infrastructure, automotive, energy, and appliances sectors.

revenue_breakup.desc: Hot-rolled plates, automotive cold-rolled coils, galvanized sheets, and prepainted color sheets.
High-tensile TMT re-bars, structural angles, and alloy steel wire rods for construction.
Electrical steel (CRGO joint venture with JFE Steel), blast furnace slag, and coal chemicals.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 83% • International Exports (Southern Europe, Middle East, USA): 17%
moats_and_strengths: Vijayanagar complex is one of the world's largest single-site steel plants, operating at industry-leading conversion costs.
Strategic technology and equity partnership with JFE Steel Corporation, Japan, for high-grade electrical and auto steel.
Proximity of Dolvi plant to coastal deepwater jetty, providing cheap ocean freight for raw material imports.
Extensive retail branded footprint through over 18,000 JSW Shoppe and retailer touchpoints.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Crude Steel Capacity: 29.7 MTPA (India) • Expanding towards 38.5 MTPA capacity target by 2026

bullish_triggers: Vijayanagar Phase-3 expansion adding 5 MTPA of low-cost steel capacity.
Commissioning of the grain-oriented electrical steel (CRGO) plant with JFE Steel addressing green transformer demand.
Securing commercial iron ore blocks in Odisha auctions lowering raw material merchant premiums.
bearish_risks: Dependence on merchant iron ore and imported coking coal relative to 100% integrated peers.
Elevated consolidated net debt levels incurred during aggressive brownfield capex phases.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
